name: Create and edit a task with durable details
description: Verifies a user can create a task with metadata, edit it, and retain the result after reload.
steps: Create a task named 'Ship portfolio' with a project, priority, due date, and note
Edit 'Ship portfolio' and change its priority
expected: The edited task and its saved details remain visible after refresh.

name: Complete and restore a task
description: Verifies completion is reversible and the progress metric responds to the state change.
expected: The task becomes completed, then returns to the open state.

name: Filter and search the task list
description: Verifies filters and search narrow the task list without changing task data.
steps: Type a task or project name into Search
Click All and clear the search
expected: Each filter and search state shows only matching tasks, and All restores the full list.

name: Focus on one task with a timer
description: Verifies a user can select an open task, enter Focus, and control a focus session.
steps: Choose an open task and click its focus control
expected: Focus view shows the selected task and the timer can start and pause.

name: Delete a task and keep it deleted
description: Verifies deletion removes a task from the workspace and the removal persists after reload.
setup: Create a task named 'Delete me' using the new-task form
steps: Click the delete control for 'Delete me'
expected: 'Delete me' is no longer visible after refresh.
